rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a cognitive memory system modeled after human memory processes. Features include persistent memory across sessions with natural decay curves, semantic vector search, trust scoring, metacognitive error prevention, and automated memory consolidation. Offers tools across categories including memory management, episodic logging, credential storage, and proactive context-triggered reminders. All data stays local with no cloud dependencies.
